topography.project_purpose: Interface. Structurally: 80 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 11 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (ownableupgradeable, contextupgradeable, automationcompatible). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
